import sys

INF = 1000000001


class Pair:
    def __init__(self, first=0, second=0):
        self.first = first
        self.second = second


def sort(arr):
    if len(arr) < 2:
        return arr
    left = 0
    right = len(arr) - 1
    pivot = len(arr) // 2

    arr[pivot], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[pivot]

    for i in range(len(arr)):
        if arr[i] < arr[right]:
            arr[i], arr[left] = arr[left], arr[i]
            left += 1

    arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]

    sort(arr[:left])
    sort(arr[left + 1:])
    return arr


def check(n):
    s = 0
    while n > 0:
        s += n % 10
        n //= 10
    return s == 10


def solution(reader, writer):
    k = int(reader.readline())
    i = 19
    while k > 0:
        if check(i):
            k -= 1
        if k == 0:
            print(i)
            return
        i += 1


def main():
    reader = sys.stdin
    writer = sys.stdout
    solution(reader, writer)
    writer.flush()


main()
